# gpucontext — Shared GPU Interfaces for GoGPU

> Cross-package contract for GPU resource sharing. Interfaces and opaque handle types used by all GoGPU ecosystem packages.

## Docs

- [gpucontext API](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gpucontext): DeviceProvider, EventSource, WindowProvider, PlatformProvider, opaque handles
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/gogpu/gpucontext/blob/main/AGENTS.md): AI agent instructions for this package

## Ecosystem

- [GoGPU Ecosystem](https://github.com/gogpu/gogpu/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Full ecosystem map and instructions
- [gogpu](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gogpu): App framework (implements DeviceProvider)
- [wgpu](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/wgpu): WebGPU implementation (handle helpers)
- [gg](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/gg): 2D graphics (consumes DeviceProvider)
- [ui](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/gogpu/ui): GUI toolkit (consumes EventSource, WindowProvider)

## Community

- [GitHub](https://github.com/gogpu/gpucontext)
- [Open Collective](https://opencollective.com/gogpu)
